q1: SELECT DISTINCT AUTHOR_ID AS ID FROM VIEWS WHERE AUTHOR_ID = VIEWER_ID ORDER BY ID
q2: SELECT DISTINCT A.AUTHOR_ID AS ID FROM VIEWS A, VIEWS B WHERE A.AUTHOR_ID = B.VIEWER_ID AND A.ARTICLE_ID = B.ARTICLE_ID ORDER BY A.AUTHOR_ID ASC

explanation: Q1 filters views where the author and viewer are the same, while Q2 finds distinct author IDs that have viewed the same articles as other viewers.
counterexample_dsp: A scenario where an author has written an article that has been viewed by another user, and this user has also written an article that has been viewed by the author.
